item.title: Financial ombud's banking division returns over R60m to consumers as fraud complaints surge
item.description: Fraud complaints once again dominated the caseload in 2025. Mobile and internet banking fraud together accounted for 39% of all complaints received by the Banking Division, with online banking fraud complaints rising by 15% compared with 2024.

item.title: Deepavali recognised by Unesco as intangible cultural heritage of humanity
item.description: Ram Maharaj, the president of the South African Hindu Maha Sabha, said the measure by Unesco would &quot;impact the world&quot; and South Africa positively and pragmatically.

item.title: Vandalism surge threatens traffic signals in eThekwini
item.description: The damage to traffic lights has not only impaired the ability of the city to maintain reliable traffic signal operations, but it has also led to exorbitant repair costs.

item.title: KwaZulu-Natal triple-murder accused Inkosi Zuma faces Christmas behind bars
item.description: THE Nxamalala Tribal Authority's traditional leader, Inkosi Simphiwe Zuma, faces Christmas behind bars after his triple murder case was postponed to next year.

item.title: DA considers criminal charges after MK Party's unruly behaviour in KZN Legislature
item.description: Members of the EFF and the MK Party marched in Pietermaritzburg on Monday to show their support for the motion of no confidence against Premier Thami Ntuli.

item.title: Govt confident lower power tariff deal for ferrochrome smelters is within reach
item.description: Speaking to the media on Monday, Ramokgopa said the proposed range was significantly lower than the 87c/kWh currently on the table and would bring South African smelters closer to the pricing enjoyed by competitors in other jurisdictions.

item.title: Marshall Monteagle triples headline earnings in six-month period
item.description: Marshall Monteagle, the JSE-listed import and distribution group said International trade remains affected by geopolitical tensions and weak global demand, however the company's directors cautiously optimistic that physical shipment volumes will continue to increase during the second half of the current financial year.

item.title: Wife married in community of property gets share in estate after 30 years of service in marriage
item.description: Divorce court rules in favour of wife after 30 years of dedicated service to her husband.

item.title: Beanies4Babies warms hearts and heads in neonatal units across South Africa
item.description: Today, Beanies4Babies operates across four provinces and 12 hospitals, distributing more than 1 500 hand-made items each month to facilities nationwide.
